observations.observedConsumerNeed: Save and independently reload a binding without losing exact source values or reference identity.
plausibleInterpretations: Exact source text with optional retrieval identity and supplied external resources
observations.meaningDifference: A plain JavaScript parse can round large values; missing resource identity changes reference resolution or prevents establishment.
observations.upstreamAnswerOrGap: OpenAPI reference resolution uses resource bases; it does not define an OpenBindings source carrier.
observations.minimumSharedMeaningOrSilence: A future kind needs an unambiguous source carrier and explicit resource/base semantics. It need not mandate embedded resources or an acquisition mechanism.
observations.implementationPolicySeparated: r1 chooses JSON text, immutable supplied resources and no automatic I/O. Graph caches, URI-index data structures and embedding every resource remain implementation choices.
observations.status: observed in private r1 experiment; candidate shared meaning only, not normative text

observations.observedConsumerNeed: Identify the same mounted operation after authoring keys change.
observations.meaningDifference: Operation IDs can be absent or repeated; a referenced Path Item can be mounted at several callable paths.
observations.upstreamAnswerOrGap: OpenAPI defines path/method operations and resource-relative references; it does not define the binding locator.
allowedAlternatives: A later independently chosen locator carrier
observations.minimumSharedMeaningOrSilence: The kind must establish locator interpretation and identity. r1 uses exact entry path plus lowercase method. Generated OBI names and inspection sourceRefs are not execution selectors.
observations.implementationPolicySeparated: Naming suggestions, lookup maps and enumeration order need no portable algorithm. Literal Unicode client limitation is not a prohibition of a future binding family.
observations.status: observed in private r1 experiment; candidate shared meaning only, not normative text

observations.observedConsumerNeed: Express path/query homonyms and distinguish no entity from JSON null.
plausibleInterpretations: Bare request object treated as body
observations.meaningDifference: Flattening aliases distinct parameters; interpreting omitted body as null sends different bytes.
observations.upstreamAnswerOrGap: OpenAPI gives parameter locations and serialization; it does not map the caller value to those declarations.
allowedAlternatives: Alternative internal scalar representations preserving exact value
observations.minimumSharedMeaningOrSilence: Specify the caller-value mapping and presence/null distinction. Delegate scalar wire serialization to the appropriate OpenAPI version instead of duplicating its rules.
observations.implementationPolicySeparated: r1 closed-envelope typo checks, duplicate-name refusal, resource limits and Rust types are implementation admission policies unless a concrete interoperability need later demands shared treatment.
observations.status: observed in private r1 experiment; candidate shared meaning only, not normative text

observations.observedConsumerNeed: Distinguish an empty successful operation from a JSON null and actionable HTTP failure.
observations.meaningDifference: The same HTTP exchange yields incompatible caller-visible values/cardinality or errors.
observations.upstreamAnswerOrGap: HTTP/OpenAPI define status and representation; the binding mapping still must choose what reaches the role caller.
allowedAlternatives: Different transports providing equivalent complete evidence
Different internal buffering within finite limits
observations.minimumSharedMeaningOrSilence: A future kind must state the output/error mapping and required completeness evidence. r1 has exact 2xx JSON, empty 204, and governed status-only failure. Error shape belongs to that chosen kind meaning, not the generic role.
observations.implementationPolicySeparated: Buffer strategy, transport implementation, redirect policy, retry policy and diagnostic detail retention should remain unspecified unless their observable result changes the selected mapping. Non-204 no-content success is an honest r1 gap, not an upstream exclusion.
observations.status: observed in private r1 experiment; candidate shared meaning only, not normative text

observations.observedConsumerNeed: Choose one declared effective server without confusing source identity, author names or list order.
observations.meaningDifference: Reordering choices can silently change an index-based target; override permits a different operation destination.
observations.upstreamAnswerOrGap: OpenAPI defines effective server declarations; caller context mapping is not supplied by OpenAPI.
observations.minimumSharedMeaningOrSilence: Specify the context point and value interpretation if server selection is part of the kind. r1 uses exact declared URL membership. Do not imply credential acquisition or an automatic retry.
observations.implementationPolicySeparated: Opaque challenge target construction, storage, UX and persistence are application/adapter policy. r1 challenge target separates source/operation/choice sets but is not an authority or trusted cache key.
observations.status: observed in private r1 experiment; candidate shared meaning only, not normative text

observations.observedConsumerNeed: Know when input is complete and whether additional input creates effects.
plausibleInterpretations: Exactly one value followed by close
observations.meaningDifference: Consumers can hang, accidentally invoke twice, or receive a false no-effect refusal after dispatch.
observations.upstreamAnswerOrGap: The role supplies lifecycle and effect-error meanings, but does not make every binding kind one-shot.
allowedAlternatives: Any implementation with the same observable cardinality/effect meaning
observations.minimumSharedMeaningOrSilence: State the input cardinality and completion meaning for the chosen binding kind. Reuse role terminal and cancellation semantics; do not prescribe Rust poll structure.
observations.implementationPolicySeparated: r1 waits for close before one request. Queue size, executor, channel type, future ownership and buffering mechanism remain implementation policy. Cancellation does not promise remote rollback.
observations.status: observed in private r1 experiment; candidate shared meaning only, not normative text

observations.observedConsumerNeed: Use synthesized documents without mistaking a mechanical envelope schema for full upstream contract translation.
plausibleInterpretations: Copy an OAS body schema to the whole caller envelope
Mechanical envelope schema plus explicit loss
observations.meaningDifference: A copied body schema validates the wrong caller shape; omitted constraints cannot truthfully count as full representation.
observations.upstreamAnswerOrGap: Core operation contracts and synthesis coverage already supply the concepts; OpenAPI dialect differences remain upstream.
observations.minimumSharedMeaningOrSilence: No binding-spec rule for synthesis naming, target-row uniqueness, coverage algorithm or internal schema projection is currently justified. Shared invocation value meaning is sufficient; documentation and coverage describe this implementation.
observations.implementationPolicySeparated: r1 derives scalar/envelope structure and omits output schemas, reports loss/unsupported/unknown distinctly, and delegates author contracts to the existing operation layer.
observations.status: observed in private r1 experiment; candidate shared meaning only, not normative text

observations.observedConsumerNeed: Avoid pretending unresolved or ambiguous source material established one portable operation.
observations.meaningDifference: Different resolutions can invoke different parameters/servers or falsely advertise complete coverage.
observations.upstreamAnswerOrGap: Resource resolution comes from upstream; undefined or unimplemented interpretations should not be invented as binding authority.
observations.minimumSharedMeaningOrSilence: Prefer existing upstream rules. No new prohibition is justified by an implementation gap. A future spec may need to identify which established source operation is addressed, while staying silent about analysis strategy.
observations.implementationPolicySeparated: r1 declines overlapping Path Item method/parameters/servers and literal Unicode templates; unknown inventory remains non-exhaustive.
observations.status: observed in private r1 experiment; candidate shared meaning only, not normative text

observations.observedConsumerNeed: Use the same Rust adapter in native and local Wasm consumers with exact values and finite ownership.
observations.meaningDifference: Machine-number conversion loses data; mandatory Send/executor assumptions can exclude local hosts.
observations.upstreamAnswerOrGap: Language and packaging choices are outside OpenBindings binding semantics.
observations.minimumSharedMeaningOrSilence: Remain silent about crate topology, language bindings, cache shape, scheduling, memory ownership and benchmarks. Require only the shared externally observable binding meaning.
observations.implementationPolicySeparated: r1 uses one immutable source cache, conditional Send, GAT transport future, finite budgets and an exact-text probe; these are implementation and qualification evidence.
observations.status: observed in private r1 experiment; candidate shared meaning only, not normative text
